pages.text: Tobacconist includes permission-level-2 operator commands for development and QA. $(item)/tobacconist debug$() inspects a targeted crop, Drying Rack, Hanging Tobacco Bunch, or Tobacco Barrel.

pages.title: Curing Targets
pages.text: While looking at a Drying Rack or either half of a Hanging Tobacco Bunch, $(item)/tobacconist rack status$(), $(item)rack addtime <ticks>$(), and $(item)rack finish$() operate on the targeted curing block. $(item)/tobacconist debug$() also recognizes both rack and hanging targets.

pages.title: Hanging Alias
pages.text: The separate $(item)/tobacconist hanging status/addtime/finish$() commands remain available. Both command families call the same hanging-bunch debug methods.

pages.title: Barrel Commands
pages.text: Use $(item)/tobacconist barrel ferment$(), $(item)barrel age <days>$(), or $(item)barrel ruin$() while targeting a Tobacco Barrel to force those QA states.

pages.title: Test Items
pages.text: $(item)/tobacconist give help$() lists the metadata-aware QA item generator. It can create raw/cured leaves, loose tobacco, blends, Cigarettes, Cigars, and Shisha with controlled processing values.
